paper.title: SP$^2$ec: Adaptive Self-Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models

settings.name_in_paper: Single-peak cost-aware bandit for adaptive self-speculative decoding (wall-time regret)
unmapped: Each arm i has a known deterministic per-round cost c_i (affine in the number of retained components); objective is the ratio nu_i = mu_i / c_i (tokens per second)
The learner knows the cost profile {c_i}
Horizon is a random stopping time tau (EOS token), not a fixed T
Rewards (accepted-token lengths) lie in [1, L+1]; only the conditional mean given the history is stationary (Assumption 3.1), not an i.i.d. distribution
Single-peak structure follows from diminishing returns in mu along ordered arms and affine costs
settings.definition_quote: There exists a function $\mu:\calS\to [1,L+1]$, such that $\bbE[\len(x_{S_t,t})\mid S_t,\calH_{t-1},\prompt] = \mu_{S_t}$. ... $\WTReg(\Lambda,\prompt):=\bbE[\WT_{\ST(\alg,\prompt,\Lambda)}]-\bbE[\WT_{\ST(\alg^*,\prompt,\Lambda)}]$.

symbols.H_wt: hardness parameter H(Lambda,pt) = sum over neighbours i of i* of (1/(nu_{i*} c_i)) * 8 L^2/(nu_{i*} - nu_i)
symbols.E_tau: expected number of speculative decoding rounds (stopping time) E[tau]
symbols.nu_i: decoding speed mu_i / c_i of arm i
symbols.c_i: known deterministic cost of arm i

conditions: Assumption 3.1: stationary conditional mean of accepted tokens
Assumption 3.2: diminishing returns of mu along ordered configurations
Assumption 3.3: affine time cost c(s) = kappa*s + b, deterministic and known
tuning: confidence radius cr = (L/2) sqrt((1+T_i)/T_i^2 (1 + 2 ln(3 Ttilde^2 (1+T_i)^{1/2})))
leader forced-sampled every third local time

source.label: thm:spsqec

results.notes: Wall-time regret is extra expected decoding time (seconds) relative to always using the best arm. That is a cost-weighted pull-count regret, so quantity is 'other'. The bound is the explicit leading term H*ln E[tau] plus an instance-dependent O(1) that does not depend on E[tau]; it is recorded with notation O. Horizon is a random stopping time (EOS), so it is recorded as anytime.
